"ClipBox es una forma limpia y tranquila de ver películas y series en Android. Todo está en un mismo sitio, así que puedes explorar lo más popular, buscar algo concreto o retomar justo donde lo dejaste.
Los subtítulos se buscan y se sincronizan por ti en muchos idiomas, cada título ofrece varias fuentes, y lo que estés viendo se puede enviar a un Chromecast o a una smart TV. La aplicación funciona en móviles, tablets, Android TV y Fire TV, y una cuenta opcional mantiene tu lista y tu historial al día en todos ellos.
ClipBox lo hace un equipo pequeño que lo usa a diario, y mejora gracias a lo que nos cuenta la gente."

ClipBox is an independent media front-end for Android. It does not host, store, upload, transmit or control any video, audio, subtitle or other media content. Everything played through the app is provided by third-party sources that are not affiliated with, endorsed by or controlled by ClipBox, and that may change or disappear at any time. ClipBox claims no ownership of third-party content and does not authorise copyright infringement. You are solely responsible for ensuring that your use of the app and of any source complies with the copyright, licensing and other laws that apply where you are. Requests to remove or disable access to content should be directed to the third-party source or rights holder concerned, as ClipBox holds no content to remove. Title and artwork metadata is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). ClipBox is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Subtitles may come from OpenSubtitles and may be machine-translated, so their accuracy and timing are not guaranteed. Netflix, IMDb, TMDB, OpenSubtitles, Google, Chromecast, Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Amazon, ExoPlayer, Media3, DLNA and all other names and trademarks are used for identification only and imply no sponsorship, endorsement or affiliation.

ClipBox does not host or provide any media content. All streams, subtitles and artwork come from third-party sources. ClipBox is not affiliated with or endorsed by Netflix, IMDb, TMDB, OpenSubtitles, Google, Amazon or any content provider.
